pages.title: DeskVNC: an AI agent that can drive your remote desktops
pages.description: DeskVNC is one native client for VNC, RDP and SSH on Windows, macOS and Linux. Its dvv MCP server lets an AI agent open a saved machine, read the screen and send clicks and keystrokes over the protocol, with nothing installed on the target.

pages.title: Benchmarks: 19 ms from screen to action on a real desktop
pages.description: Measured agent plane performance for DeskVNC: 19 ms per observe then act cycle, 4 ms to open and attach, under 1 ms to acquire control, 25 ms for a quarter scale screen and 447 characters per second typing, on a real 1920x1080 Windows desktop over a LAN.
